usedFor: Pivotal Tracker holds your stories, and Teamwork receives a matching task when “New Story” runs “Create Task”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Story” in Pivotal Tracker, then “Create Task” in Teamwork
bestTemplate.why: Work planned in one tool shows up for the team in the other without anyone copying it.

watchOut: “New Story” in Pivotal Tracker is polling, so “Create Task” follows after a scheduled check.
